(1) CGs are significantly overrepresented in hub proteins and in particular network motifs, (2) CMGs are significantly overrepresented at the source nodes of network motifs, and (3) CGs are overrepresented at the target nodes of network motifs.

the CGs and CMGs are enriched or depleted in particular network motifs and that CGs are concentrated on the convergent target node of most network motifs and CMGs are concentrated on the source node of most network motif types.
the cancer-associated genes are enriched in the hub proteins and the convergent targets of network motifs, and that the cell mobility genes are enriched in network motifs with source nodes.

the regulatory mechanisms of signalling networks in the development of cancer.
